questions.q: What is the output of A OR B when A = 1 and B = 1?
questions.why: OR gives 1 if at least one input is 1, including both.

questions.q: How many rows are needed in a truth table for a logic statement with 3 inputs?
Which statement describes: a light comes on if the switch (S) is on and it is not daytime (D)?
questions.why: Both conditions are needed (AND) and daytime must be false (NOT D).

questions.q: What is a trace table used for?
questions.model: It records the values of variables (and any output) as an algorithm is followed step by step, so you can find its output, its purpose, or where an error occurs.
points: records variable values step by step
